title: Australasian AI Research Gatherings: Connecting NeurIPS 2026 with the AJCAI 2026 and ACML 2026
subtitle: As we prepare to welcome the global AI and machine learning community to NeurIPS 2026 in Sydney, Australia (December 6–12), we are excited about the opportunity to strengthen connections with researchers across Australia, New Zealand, and the broader Asia-Pacific region. Research communities thrive through collaboration, the exchange of ideas, and opportunities to connect across institutions […]
